row.Finding: ABS is prone to warping when printing a large size and/or high infill density model. To avoid warping: 1) Not recommended to print too large size and/or high infill density model. 2) Use enclosure printers and ensure the build plate is properly glued before printing. 3) Set lower printing speed and higher heatbed temperature. For more details please refer to: Common print quality problems and solutions on WIKI.
